# Hugo Narrow 2.1.1

Final release of Hugo Narrow 2.x. The v2 line is no longer maintained.

## Fixes

- Fixed the CRLF build failure caused by multi-line template comments. Windows checkouts with `core.autocrlf=true` failed with `comment ends before closing delimiter`; comments now close with `*/}}` on the same line. (#92)
- Bundled MiniSearch and smart-gallery files are now included when the theme is installed as a Hugo module. `assets/js/vendor` was renamed to `assets/js/lib` because Go module archives omit vendor directories. (#93)
- Made the lightbox flag and Mermaid `<pre>` output independent of template indentation.

## Maintenance

- Templates are formatted with Hugo's `gotmplfmt`; JS uses Biome. Prettier and its plugins are removed.
- `.gitattributes` forces LF working trees.
- CI installs `gotmplfmt` and checks both formatters.

## Upgrade

```bash
hugo mod get github.com/tom2almighty/hugo-narrow/v2@v2.1.1
```

No configuration changes are required.

## Final release

v2.1.1 is the last v2 release. Existing v2 sites should pin this version.
